annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act binds persons or entities operating autonomous commercial motor vehicles and submitting certification statements, remote drivers, owners and remote drivers' employers, and designates the Department of Transportation and Development as the sole authority.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: an owner, a remote driver, or the remote driver's employer shall submit a written statement to the Department of Transportation and Development certifying that the vehicle meets the requirements of this Section.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 2019 Regular Session HOUSE BILL NO. 455 ... relative to autonomous commercial motor vehicles
